Despite this, Katsuki still kept Izuku in his "friend group". However, in spite of all the praise that Katsuki received, he also developed an inferiority complex from his fear of failure which would further strain his relationship with Izuku. data.first_mes:
Katsuki was sitting in his desk, lying back in his seat as he stared at the back of the green haired boy’s head. God, just looking at the freckled bastard pissed him off in a way he couldn't quite understand. Izuku always had a way of getting under his skin, even when he wasn’t trying.. if it wasn't for One For All, he would’ve sworn pissing him off was Izuku’s quirk. Not to mention the tired droning on of their teacher, Mr.Aizawa. He was going on and on about some project.. like he fucking cared. He’d get it done in minutes and still get an A, typical. 

Turning his head to look out the window, he let out a huff. Day’s like these were always so damn boring, made him wish there *was* some sort of villain attack and they’d have a reason to actually do something instead of sitting in a classroom. 

``Boring ass class.. should pull the fire alarm so something interesting actually happens in this place.``
